name: Reading Buddies for Teens
what_you_do: Be a big buddy to a child in grades 2 to 4 once a week at a library branch. Read together and help the child enjoy reading. It is not tutoring. Library staff train and support you.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 who live in Vancouver. You need a signature from a coach, teacher, counsellor or community leader on your form, and you must come to every session.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. You earn community service hours, and the library can write a letter confirming them.
duration: One hour a week for about 8 weeks, plus a teen training session on the first date. Arrive 15 minutes early.
deadline_text: All five Fall 2026 sessions (Britannia, Fraserview, Kensington, South Hill, West Point Grey) were full on Oct 19, 2026. The Britannia session has a waitlist. Apply at least one week before a session starts. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: When new sessions are posted, fill in the online form at least one week before the start date. Get your reference person to sign it. Questions: teens@vpl.ca.
notes: If you quit without a good reason, your spot goes to a teen on the waitlist. Sessions are loud and snacks are provided.
